title: Pet-Friendly Hotels in Dayton & West Central Ohio | PetTripFinder
meta_description: Verified pet-friendly hotels across Dayton and West Central Ohio, with real pet fees and policies read from each hotel’s own official website.
introductory_copy: Every listing links to a pet policy verified directly from the hotel’s own official website.
_boundary_note: PTF-DAYTON-MARKET-FACTORY-001 regional umbrella, superseded from Dayton MSA to West Central Ohio. 12 included counties: Montgomery, Greene, Miami, Clark (Tier 1 core), Champaign, Preble, Darke, Shelby, Logan, Auglaize, Mercer, Fayette (Tier 2 regional). Hardin County excluded. Warren County excluded (Cincinnati market). This is a PetTripFinder regional discovery umbrella, not a claim that all properties are in the Dayton metro. Hotels outside Dayton must display their real city and county identities. Public corridor pages are only generated where confirmed lodging inventory supports them; thin counties are deferred.
